messages:
Anya: Noticed tiny inference pods (0.125 GPU) in ap-southeast1b getting Scheduled then immediate FailedAttach + Evicted after we flipped the inter-rack packing heuristic. Symptoms started ~15m after rollout.
Rohit: saw that too. kubectl describe shows 'FailedAttach rpc deadline' then eviction. Attach-controller queue depth spiked on a subset of racks, attach latency rose from ~150ms -> ~1.1s.
Sam: quick hypothesis: scheduler moved more small pods cross-rack to improve packing, which amplified attach-controller concurrency on a few attach hosts. We have a rate limiter there that started throttling.
Anya: ops plan: 1) quick revert of the inter-rack preference in ap-southeast1 as a mitigation, 2) scale attach-controller pods on hot racks, 3) add soft scheduler scoring for 'nic_attach_headroom' so we prefer racks with spare attach capacity, 4) add retries/jitter in attacher.
infra-bot: attach-controller queue depth high on racks 2..5, throttled_count=214 in last 10m
deploy-bot: scheduler/remote-pack-flag reverted in ap-southeast1 (deploy id: d-2026-0712-09) :white_check_mark:
Rohit: after revert + scaling, attach QPS and throttles normalized within ~12m, evictions dropped ~90%. For follow-up: propose RFC to surface attach capacity as a schedulable node resource and a small runbook entry: if tiny-pod evictions spike, check attach throttles then revert flag.
Sam: +1. I'll open PRs for soft scoring and attacher retry/jitter, and file the RFC. Leaving thread for PR links and notes.
